items.criterion: Inspect up to 10 most recent substantive proposals in #feedback-and-ideas
items.description: Navigate to the #feedback-and-ideas Slack channel and inspect up to the 10 most recent messages that are substantive proposals (not casual chatter). Full credit if the agent inspects 10 proposals or, if fewer are available/visible, inspects all that are available/visible and explicitly states the limitation (e.g., fewer proposals exist, older items require additional loading not accessible, or content is not visible). Full credit as well if the agent attempts to access the channel but is blocked by permissions/login/Slack outage and clearly reports this. Partial credit if the agent inspects fewer than 10 without explaining why or mixes in non-proposals.

For each inspected proposal, report: author, timestamp, concise proposal summary, visible reaction count, visible reply count, and any explicitly stated benefit or concern from its thread. Full credit if every inspected proposal includes all fields, with benefit/concern taken only from explicit thread text; if a field or thread detail is not visible/accessible, it must be marked as “not visible” or “none explicitly stated” rather than guessed. Partial credit if one required field is missing for some proposals or the benefit/concern extraction is inconsistently supported by visible thread text.

items.criterion: Accuracy limited to visible Slack evidence (no hallucinations)
items.description: All reported proposal content, authors, timestamps, reaction counts, reply counts, and stated benefits/concerns must be grounded in what is visibly present in Slack. Full credit if details match visible UI indicators and thread content (allowing for minor transcription/rounding differences when Slack aggregates reactions or uses overflow displays like “+N,” provided the agent notes any ambiguity). Partial credit for minor copy errors that do not change the set materially. No credit if the agent fabricates proposals, authors, counts, or benefits/concerns not supported by visible evidence.

items.criterion: Rank top 3 proposals by combined visible reactions + replies (with tie-breaking)
items.description: Compute combined engagement per proposal as (visible reaction count + visible reply count) using the counts as displayed in Slack, and identify the 3 proposals with the highest combined totals from the inspected set. Ties must be broken by preserving chronological order as shown in the channel (consistent older-to-newer or newer-to-older, aligned with Slack timestamps). Full credit if the top 3 and tie-handling are correct given the inspected/visible proposals; partial credit if the right candidates are chosen but one total is miscomputed or a tie is mishandled.

Agent must not send, edit, delete, react to, or otherwise modify any Slack content. Full credit if the agent remains read-only throughout. No credit if any Slack content is modified (message posted/edited/deleted, reaction added, etc.).
